title: Adjunct of raw triangle pullback
statement: For Λ, a : Y′ → Y, h : Y → S, any integer q, derived module sheaves K,K′, v : D⁺a* K → K′, U étale over S, and a represented class z, the derived adjunct of the raw triangle pullback of z equals the adjunct of z followed by the mate of the canonical pullback-composition comparison, at K[q] and K′[q] with coefficient map (D⁺a*).commShiftIso(q).hom(K) followed by v[q]. This is an equality of derived morphisms before applying homology.

proof.text: Invert the existing upperStarPlusComp_single commuting square to obtain the comparison from the single of the composite pullback to the iterated derived pullback of the single. The inverse square identity follows by cancellation with the comparison isomorphisms.
Expand the raw triangle pullback into its four factors. Combine its first two factors with the single comparison by the previous square.

Apply the inverse of the derived adjunction hom equivalence to both sides. Naturality of the left-adjoint comparison moves the adjunct through it; the counit identity cancels the adjunction equivalence. This proves the equality of derived morphisms without applying homology or making any assumption on the degree q.

theorem higherDirectImageRawTrianglePullback_adjunct
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {Y Y' S : Scheme.{u}}
    (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ S) (q : ℤ)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
    (K' : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
    (v : D+((a)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj K ⟶ K') (U : S.Etale)
    (z : (higherDirectImagePresheaf Λ h q K).obj (op U)) :
    (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunctionPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (a ≫ h)).homEquiv _ _
      (((((a ≫ h)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app
          ((freeSheaf Λ S).obj U)) ≫
        higherDirectImageRawTrianglePullback Λ a h (a ≫ h) rfl q K K' v U z) =
    (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunctionPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) h).homEquiv _ _
      (((((h)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app
          ((freeSheaf Λ S).obj U)) ≫ z) ≫
      (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) h).derivedPlus.transitionThrough
        (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (a ≫ h)).derivedPlus
        D+((a)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ])
        (upperStarPlusComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) a h).hom (K⟦q⟧) (K'⟦q⟧)
        ((D+((a)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).commShiftIso q).hom.app K ≫
          (shiftFunctor _ q).map v)
